kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-policy
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "this" {
  bucket = "b"

  dynamic "bucket_policy" {
    for_each = var.policies
    content {
      name = bucket_policy.value.name
    }
  }
}

variable "policies" {
  type = any
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "this" {
  bucket = "b"

  dynamic "bucket_policy" {
    for_each = var.policies
    content {
      name = bucket_policy.value.id
    }
  }
}

variable "policies" {
  type = any
}
